links.comparator_used: Minimal-guidance prompt relying on the model's built-in knowledge (baseline prompt without explicit guidelines)
links.outcome: Accuracy/AUC of neuraxial bleeding risk assessment versus ASRA guideline-based truth table
links.effect: Baseline GPT-3.5 performance was slightly above chance; with detailed prompts and explicit guidelines, performance improved significantly (AUC 0.70, 95% CI 0.64 to 0.77)
links.quote: With detailed prompts and explicit guidelines, performance improved significantly (AUC 0.70, 95% CI (0.64 to 0.77)).

design_hint: structured prompt guidance with explicit guideline instructions
